_readme: THE BOOK VALUE STORE. This is the only file you edit to update the dashboard.
Change a 'bvps' number, set its 'asOf' to the quarter it came from, commit, push.
Netlify redeploys and the dashboard picks it up — no build step, no code change.
bvps       ₹ per share. Book value per share as most recently reported.
asOf       The quarter that bvps came from, e.g. 'Q1FY27'. Shown on every row.
shares     Shares outstanding. Used ONLY for market cap in the expanded row.
sharesAsOf When that share count was last checked. Stale shares only skew market
cap — never P/B, which uses bvps directly.
symbol     NSE code as Twelve Data expects it (no .NS suffix).
source: nbfc_data_cache.py — same figures as the Streamlit dashboard, Q1FY27
